settings.heading: Soak n Go vs the others
settings.content: If you're standing in an aisle (or a search results page) comparing us with fast-acting bleach cleaners and mix-it-yourself concentrates — good. Compare away. Here's the whole picture, feature by feature, in plain English.

settings.label: No mixing — clicks onto the hose
Keeps working for weeks after application
Subscribe & Save so you never run out

settings.heading: Fast results you rinse off vs lasting results you walk away from
settings.content:
Bleach-based cleaners (the '30 seconds' style of product) are genuinely fast — that's their whole pitch. The trade-off is the bleach itself: the fumes, the careful handling, protecting everything nearby, and rinsing the result away when you're done. And because the active washes off, the growth gets to start again from scratch.

Soak n Go makes the opposite trade. No bleach, no acid, nothing to rinse. You lose the instant gratification and gain a result that keeps improving for weeks and holds for much longer. Soak once, walk away.

settings.heading: Same patience. Way less faff.
settings.content: Mix-it-yourself concentrates (the 'wet and forget it' style of product) share our walk-away philosophy — we're not going to pretend otherwise. Where we differ is everything around the formula: Soak n Go's hose-end bottle clicks straight onto the garden hose with no mixing, no pump sprayer and no measuring jug. It's NZ made and owned, designed by a professional exterior cleaning company that washes buildings every day, and Subscribe & Save keeps a refill turning up before you run out.

settings.question: Why don't you name specific competitor products in the table?
settings.answer: Because formulations change and we'd rather compare honestly on category characteristics — bleach-based fast-acting cleaners versus mix-yourself concentrates — than argue over someone else's label. Check any product's label against ours and draw your own conclusions.

settings.question: Is slower actually better?
settings.answer: For lasting results outdoors, yes. Weather-activated cleaning keeps working on the growth and its regrowth for weeks. Instant products give you a great Saturday-afternoon photo; the question is what it looks like in six months.

settings.heading: Try the walk-away method
settings.text: One 2L hose-end bottle covers up to 250 m². If it doesn't work, we'll make it right.
